name: panel-t12
summary: Enforce the panel datasheet's T12 (VLCD off >= 1 s before it may return): panel-on waits for the vendor's own 1.2 s off-timer

edits.asm: b.jal sub_23ccd5 -> b.jal wait_t12 (full panel-on sub_245919)
b.jal sub_23ccd5 -> b.jal wait_t12 (panel-on without link sub_2457FB (stock pre-standby cancel))

notes: sub_245860 (panel off) arms a 1200 ms countdown (0x4551B6, flag off=0x4551A7) that the 1 ms ISR (sub_240C55) decrements, clearing off at 0; no panel-on path checked it, so VLCD could be re-applied < 1 s after removal (LM270WR8 spec 3-6, T12 >= 1000 ms). Both panel-on routines now wait for off == 0 before powering the panel (1 ms steps, at most 1200 steps, so a stalled timer cannot hang the loop). Nothing waits when the panel was off long enough.
